Incrementally refresh saved Outlook forecast tables

Source: R/outlook-update.R
update_boj_outlook.Rd

Checks the live archive and every linked Bank's View/full-text asset using HTTP validators where available and SHA-256 otherwise. A changed URL, source hash or parser invalidates only its dependent editions (all editions after a parser change). Unchanged numeric tables are reused. Missing historical editions fail validation rather than silently reducing coverage.

Usage

update_boj_outlook(
  data_dir = boj_outlook_data_dir(),
  force = FALSE,
  rebuild = FALSE,
  timeout = 30,
  retries = 2L,
  wait = 0.1,
  max_bytes = 16 * 1024^2,
  max_total_bytes = 256 * 1024^2,
  max_releases = 200L,
  max_pdf_pages = 20L,
  max_text_bytes = 1024^2,
  pdftotext = getOption("readboj.pdftotext", unname(Sys.which("pdftotext"))),
  deadline = NULL,
  allow_coverage_loss = FALSE
)

Arguments

data_dir

Persistent user directory also used by ordinary reads.

force

Bypass daily attempt throttling.

rebuild

Reparse all editions, including unchanged sources.

timeout, retries, wait

Per-request timeout, bounded retry count and delay.

max_bytes

Per-source response bound.

max_total_bytes

Total downloaded raw bytes per transaction; also bounds staged raw bytes. All staging is temporary.

max_releases

Maximum discovered editions (1 through 1,000).

max_pdf_pages, max_text_bytes, pdftotext

See read_boj_outlook_raw().

deadline

Caller-owned absolute deadline; default thirty minutes.

allow_coverage_loss

Explicit reviewed opt-in to removing existing logical scalar identities/targets from an edition. Default FALSE rejects partial-but-otherwise-valid revisions. When enabled, removed identities and original rows/receipts remain in revision history and the outcome reports the reduction. Use force = TRUE for a same-day retry after rejection.

Value

A status list: updated, unchanged, or throttled, identities, changed assets/editions, parse counts, bytes downloaded and publication size. Failures raise a typed error and leave a failed local check receipt.

Details

A complete candidate is validated before an atomic commit. The package bundle is read-only. Readers use the newest valid local generation, falling back with an explicit warning if it is corrupt. One writer holds a process lock; checks are throttled to once per UTC day unless forced or the parser changed. Failed attempts are recorded separately and never replace good data.

Raw staging is deleted on success/error and at the next locked run after a crash. No raw documents are retained. At most three structured generations and thirty check receipts remain. Revision history within the current snapshot retains superseded tables and receipts, with a 32 MiB serialized-file bound; exceeding a bound fails without discarding history.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
update_boj_outlook(data_dir = boj_outlook_data_dir(),
                   deadline = Sys.time() + 1800)
} # }
